'''The Mysterious Beauty''' (Japanese: '''なぞの美少女·ジンジャー登場''' ''Enter the Mysterious Beauty Ginger'') is the 37th chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
A beautiful woman, called "big sister" by [[Coconut]], comes to town.

==Major events==
* [[Ginger]] and her {{p|Natu}} are introduced.
===Debuts===
* [[Ginger]]
====Pokémon debuts====
* {{p|Natu}}
* {{p|Girafarig}}

==Characters==
===Humans===
* [[Ginger]]
* [[Coconut]]
* [[Grandpa]]
* [[Hazel]]
* [[Almond]]

===Pokémon=== 
* {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Hazel|Pikachu}})
* {{p|Clefairy}} ({{OP|Hazel|Clefairy}})

* {{p|Squirtle}} ({{MPJ|Squirtle|Magical Pokémon Journey)}}
* {{p|Natu}}
* {{p|Girafarig}}

==Trivia==
* This chapter was originally released between ''[[PPP35|Poké-Mom]]'' and ''[[PPP36|Green Jealousy]]'', in ''[[Ciao]]'' magazine, under the title '''''ジンジャー来襲''''' (''Ginger Invasion'').
===Errors===
*In the English translation by [[VIZ Media]], the cover for this chapter was labelled with the title of the next chapter, ''[[PPP38|Swimming with the Qwilfish]]''. This error is not present in the [[Chuang Yi]] version.
